i.norm: Encoding value 141 selects a population codec whose favoured, token and unfavoured sub-codecs are each read from the supplied header stream. Each sub-codec byte is 0, so {@link CodecEncoding#getCodec} reads three bytes from the stream before returning. The header bytes are wrapped in a {@link BufferedInputStream}, which reads the whole underlying buffer ahead in a single gulp. As a result the backing {@link ByteArrayInputStream} reports nothing left to read once getCodec returns.
Header stream of nine zero bytes; getCodec only needs the first three.
Value 141 => population codec, reading three sub-codec bytes.
BufferedInputStream pulled the entire backing buffer into its buffer.
